svg.title: Software Factory — autonomous digital production
svg.desc: A wide cinematic industrial software factory in deep navy, metallic silver, cyan and subtle violet. Seven named production stations use robotic arms to assemble holographic requirements, source code, APIs, microservices, tested and secured software, delivery pipelines and finished applications. Glass architecture dashboards, Git repositories, telemetry, engineers and AI agents overlook an organized production floor. Finished web and mobile applications flow toward cloud servers.
